name: QA engineer
description: Tests products and reports defects with agents.

axes.name: Test design
axes.measures: Scenarios cover requirements, edge cases and risks

axes.name: Reproduction
axes.measures: Defects come with exact, repeatable steps and evidence

axes.name: Coverage
axes.measures: Checks reach the changed areas and regressions around them

axes.name: Bug reports
axes.measures: Reports are clear enough for a developer to act without questions
